question: Which native hook relay observability shape should remain open for the Codex relay fan-out investigation?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101099 both instrument the same relay investigation, and choosing aggregate counters versus timing logs is an operations/product judgment rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Use This Aggregate Metrics PR After Proof
options.body: After the contributor adds redacted real relay/log proof, land this per-registration aggregate metrics path and treat the overlapping relay-timing portion of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101099 as superseded or split separately.

options.title: Prefer The Timing PR
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the duration-log shape in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101099 instead of aggregate relay counters.

options.title: Wait For The Behavior Fix First
options.body: Keep both instrumentation PRs paused until maintainers choose the canonical relay fan-out mitigation path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91009.

recommendation.title: Use This Aggregate Metrics PR After Proof
recommendation.body: After the contributor adds redacted real relay/log proof, land this per-registration aggregate metrics path and treat the overlapping relay-timing portion of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101099 as superseded or split separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent relay work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the observability shape.
